attribution: receipt-envelope-profile v0.1 R2 — the boundary of the envelope refusal, added with it on 2026-09-25
rationale: The bundle names OUR identifier and then an algorithm our schema does not allow. That is judgeable: proofbundle/v0.1 fixes `signature.alg`, so a bundle that claims the format and breaks it is `invalid`. Our verifier raises the same exception type here as for a foreign identifier, so an implementation that turned every such exception into a refusal would pass the vector above and fail this one. A refusal needs a foreign identifier, not an unsupported value.
